result.title: Neural Disjunctive Normal Forms for Learning Exact Rank Filters
result.summary: Gradient-based learning of morphological operators is hindered by locally sparse derivatives with respect to the structuring elements. We develop a method for learning rank filters that retains exact operator evaluation while distributing the derivatives across the window. Using threshold decomposition, we construct a neural disjunctive normal form representation and establish a sufficient condition for exactness with integer-valued images and structuring elements. We then derive a smooth surrogate from the unique root of a smooth threshold equation. Implicit differentiation gives closed-form derivatives with normalised local weights, whose distribution is controlled by a smoothing parameter. These derivatives are used in a straight-through procedure: the forward pass evaluates the exact rank filter, while the backward pass uses the surrogate. For fixed ranks, the procedure learns real-valued structuring elements of any rank filter, including the median, and extends to compositions, infima, and suprema of rank filters. Experiments on image denoising using MNIST and Fashion-MNIST and retinal vessel segmentation show that, starting from a generic random initialisation, the proposed approach consistently improves performance over training with exact subgradients in every setting. In image denoising, our best network also outperforms smooth morphological networks in all settings. On vessel segmentation, the learned erosions recover structuring elements that fit the vessels, as theoretically expected, whereas most of those trained with exact subgradients remain close to their initialisation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用阈值分解构造 neural disjunctive normal form 来表示 rank filter，给出整数图像下精确性的充分条件，并由平滑阈值方程的根导出光滑代理，借隐式微分得到闭式导数，在 straight-through 框架中前向精确评估、反向用代理，用于去噪与血管分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「前向精确、反向平滑代理」且由平滑参数控制窗口内权重分配的梯度机制，可能可供核查 LVR 中硬性视觉证据筛选（如 top-k patch 选择、阈值门控）的梯度回传与贡献分配问题，但任务场景距离主线较远。
